_doc: Macro-region share copy for /region/<slug> deeplinks. Labels must match normRegion() output in scripts/region-share.mjs.

southeast-asia.tagline: Archipelagos, super-apps, and the missing premium water tier.
southeast-asia.summary: Southeast Asia is the world's densest archipelagic mobility market: Indonesia's 17,000 islands, Thailand's island chains, Malaysia's cross-border corridors, the Philippines' airport-to-resort hops, and Singapore's regulator-led clean-harbour push. Super-apps already own last-mile demand — the water leg is the premium tier still sold by diesel ferry and wet speedboat. Explore clusters, cities, and sealed corridors on Navier Atlas.

mena.tagline: Gulf islands, Red Sea resorts, and cross-emirate water mobility.
mena.summary: The Middle East and North Africa combine captive resort islands, congested coastal cities, and ambitious national mobility programs. From the UAE's harbour craft mandates to Red Sea gateway resorts and Mediterranean riviera hops, marine mobility is the premium overlay super-apps and hospitality groups are still assembling by road and helicopter.

europe.tagline: Riviera corridors, fjords, and island-hopping at electric range.
europe.summary: Europe's coastal cities, archipelagos, and short-sea corridors are ideal foiling territory: Greek islands, Croatian Adriatic hops, Norwegian fjords, Mediterranean marinas, and cross-channel commuter links where congestion and seasonality already price premium transfer.

south-asia.tagline: Mega-city rivers, island gateways, and super-app scale.
south-asia.summary: South Asia pairs some of the world's largest urban populations with island and backwater corridors — Kerala's waterways, Sri Lanka's coast, India's Andaman gateway, and Bangladesh's delta geography. Ride-hailing scale meets water surfaces that ferries and roads cannot serve cleanly.

east-asia.tagline: Island nations, inland seas, and high-frequency coastal demand.
east-asia.summary: East Asia spans Japan's inland sea and Ryukyu chains, Korea's coastal cities, Taiwan's island hops, and Greater China's Pearl River Delta — dense, tech-forward markets where premium water mobility can slot into existing super-app habits.

latin-america.tagline: Coastal megacities, Caribbean gateways, and tourism archipelagos.
latin-america.summary: Latin America combines Pacific and Atlantic coastal corridors, Caribbean leisure islands, and congested waterfront cities where a quiet foiling tier unlocks resort transfers and commuter relief without new highway spend.

caribbean.tagline: Island-hopping leisure and inter-island essential mobility.
caribbean.summary: The Caribbean is defined by water — resort transfers, inter-island commuters, and cruise-gateway hops where diesel ferries and small aircraft are the only options today. A premium electric-hydrofoil mesh raises reliability and cuts noise across short-sea corridors.

north-america.tagline: Harbour cities, island metros, and coastal congestion relief.
north-america.summary: North America's harbour cities and coastal corridors — from Pacific Northwest islands to Florida keys, NYC harbour commuting, and Great Lakes gateways — are natural foiling markets where water is faster than gridlocked road.

oceania.tagline: Pacific archipelagos and Australasian coastal gateways.
oceania.summary: Oceania spans Australia's harbour cities, New Zealand's coastal corridors, and Pacific island chains where inter-island transport is essential infrastructure and tourism depends on reliable water links.

africa.tagline: Coastal cities, island states, and emerging super-app corridors.
africa.summary: Africa's coastal megacities, island nations, and lake corridors combine essential mobility demand with rapidly scaling ride-hailing platforms — a greenfield premium water tier for corridors ferries serve slowly today.

caspian.tagline: Inland sea corridors between energy and tourism gateways.
caspian.summary: The Caspian basin links Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, and Turkmenistan coastal cities across an inland sea where cross-shore mobility is ferry-dependent and ripe for a premium foiling overlay.
